WE LOVE YOU BOTH SO MUCH!


Tulsi Gabbard 🌺 (@TulsiGabbard)

We are getting ready to head to the hospital for my husband’s surgery and just wanted to say thank you so much to all of who have shared messages, prayers and well wishes for Abraham.  We are humbled and so grateful to be surrounded by aloha during this really tough time.  🙏🏽

Acyn (@Acyn)

Egbewole: Platner is cosplaying working class. He wears it as a Halloween costume. That has been placed on him by the same people who have run a lot of Progressive candidates across the nation

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Acyn/status/2061635629461717105#m

😂😂😂


Jarvis (@jarvis_best)

I can excuse a LOT of bad behavior - even downright evil and sociopathic behavior - so long as it allows us to get rid of history’s greatest monster, Susan Collins.

Joining my friends @GaydosKTAR and @TheBruceStJames on @OutspokenKTAR for “Mondays with Meghan” on @KTAR923 - tune in at the top of the hour Arizonans! 🌵🌵🌵

CBS News is officially more dramatic than a housewives reunion. Well done all the way around everyone.


Brian Stelter (@brianstelter)

Scott Pelley: "She is murdering 60 Minutes. She does not love this place. She was brought in to kill it, and she’s been doing exactly that."

Video

If Ted Cruz had a Nazi tattoo and was accused of doing everything Graham Platner has done democrats would be crying literal tears on meet the press demanding his resignation and saying he was an insult to our constitution. 

Be 👏🏻 for 👏🏻 real 👏🏻

Lolz - sure, Jan,


Morris Katz (@katz_morris)

It’s no one’s fucking business what happened in Graham & Amy’s marriage before he was ever a candidate for office. 

There should be no place in our politics for incompetent, opportunistic operatives who violate privacy, betray trust, and prioritize vengeance over decency.



— https://nitter.net/katz_morris/status/2060806954818118044#m

It's actually crazy how threatened democrats are by Spencer's rise.


Tommy Vietor (@TVietor08)

Spencer Pratt’s closing message is: I want to lock up my political opponents and by the way let me tell you some hippy shit about crystals.



— https://nitter.net/TVietor08/status/2060360171050909935#m

I’ll survive, Nan.


Nan White (@eyesbrowngirl)

Do you realize how trashy your mouth reflects on you as a person.



— https://nitter.net/eyesbrowngirl/status/2060386122664931489#m

Gotta take the wins where I can.
